contexts.text: Index to the Memorabilia, 11. A type of the creation of the universe was shown me, to the life... The Angels said, All these (spiritual objects) are created by God in a moment... and this instantaneous creation evidently testifies the creation of like things, nay, a like creation, in the natural world, with the sole difference that natural things invest spiritual ones, and that this clothing has been provided by God for the sake of the generative processes of one from another, by which creation is perpetuated: consequently, that the creation of the universe was effected in a manner similar to that in which it is effected every moment in Heaven...
